privacy.intro: No sign-up needed. The first time you open the app, an 'anonymous ID' is created without your name or email and saved on this phone. The records below are linked to this anonymous ID.
privacy.location: Location: used only on this phone to find places nearby. It is never sent to our server.
privacy.visits: 'I'll go here' records: the place you chose, when, how far it was, and your price limit. Used to ask 'Did you go?' and to build your lunch log.
privacy.answers: 'Did you go?' answers: whether you went, whether it was open, and whether the price was right. Used to make restaurant info more accurate.
privacy.push: If you turn on notifications: the notification address your browser gives us. Used only to send the 'Did you go?' reminder. Notifications pass through your browser maker's service (Google, Apple, etc.) and are encrypted.
privacy.opinions: Feedback: what you wrote and the app language.
privacy.events: Usage records: things like which buttons you tapped, and screen errors. Used to improve the app. Your IP address is not sent.
privacy.vendors: Services we use: Supabase (anonymous sign-in, storing records), Render (server), Vercel (app pages), Amplitude (usage records). We use Google Gemini to translate app text and read restaurant info, but your records are never sent to it.
privacy.delete: To delete your data: send 'Please delete my records' through Send feedback, and we'll delete everything linked to this anonymous ID. If you clear your browser data, a new anonymous ID is created and older records are no longer linked to this phone.
privacy.keep: Retention: kept while the service runs, and deleted when it ends.
terms.free: This is a free personal project. No ads, no payments.
terms.data: Restaurant info comes from Hot Pepper Gourmet Web Service once a day. Some lunch hours and prices are judged by AI reading the restaurant's text, so they can be wrong. Please check at the restaurant before you go.
terms.liability: We can't be responsible for problems caused by app info that differs from reality.
terms.change: Features may change or stop without notice.
install.title: Add this app to your Home Screen to get 'Did you go?' reminders
install.step1: Tap your browser's Share button (a square with an up arrow). In Safari it's at the bottom of the screen.
install.step2: Tap 'Add to Home Screen'. If you don't see it, scroll down the list.
install.step3: Open the app from your Home Screen.
